_about: Terms verdict for every site render-watch has a line for (research/channel-loop/TERMS-AUDIT-2026-09-29.md). A line may be active only when its site is NOT_BARRED or CONDITIONAL_MET, or TERMS_PENDING and the line is the site's terms page (slug starting 'terms-'). Since 30.9 (RULING-2026-09-30-video.md 16(d) D2(v)) NO_TERMS_ROBOTS_OK is active-eligible too, set only by scripts/robots-verdict.mjs (its source names the script and its note opens 'exhaustive-negative'; a hand-set one fails the gate), and a robots-only probe (slug starting 'robots-', URL path exactly /robots.txt) may be active only for a NO_TERMS site whose note opens 'exhaustive-negative' (D2(iv): a TERMS_PENDING site gets its terms page and nothing else). Enforced by src/__tests__/revenue/render-watch-terms-barred.test.ts.

apify.com.note: no clause bars or conditions automated access. The nearest are GTC 4.1.1, 'Accounts registered by "bots" or other automated methods are not permitted.' (research/channel-loop/terms/apify-general-terms-2026-10-04.md:72; accounts only, and the render lines use none), and AUP 2.1(1), 'denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks or any other actions that cause undue burden on any servers or infrastructure;' (research/channel-loop/terms/apify-acceptable-use-policy-2026-10-04.md:46; a weekly handful of unauthenticated store GETs is nowhere near it). The Platform 'enables automation of manual activities and processes on internet websites' (GTC 2.1, research/channel-loop/terms/apify-general-terms-2026-10-04.md:60) and includes 'the Apify API at api.apify.com' (GTC 1.6, research/channel-loop/terms/apify-general-terms-2026-10-04.md:50); the Website is apify.com and its Apify-owned subdomains (GTC 1.9, research/channel-loop/terms/apify-general-terms-2026-10-04.md:56); the Agreement is concluded on 'your use of our Website' (GTC 14.1, research/channel-loop/terms/apify-general-terms-2026-10-04.md:182) and the AUP binds 'simply by using the Platform or the Website' (research/channel-loop/terms/apify-acceptable-use-policy-2026-10-04.md:32). The AUP's catch-alls (2.1(11) harm to Apify's reputation, 2.1(12) any activity Apify 'deems immoral or undesirable', research/channel-loop/terms/apify-acceptable-use-policy-2026-10-04.md:56-57) and GTC 15.1's right to refuse access (research/channel-loop/terms/apify-general-terms-2026-10-04.md:190) are discretionary, not an access bar. Open caveat, for storage and not access: GTC 5.2 forbids to '(ii) reproduce, share, or distribute the Website or the Services' and '(iii) create derivative or analogous works, copies of the Website or Services or any part thereof' (research/channel-loop/terms/apify-general-terms-2026-10-04.md:88), which bears on committing the store responses to a public repo (TERMS-AUDIT-2026-09-29.md:100); unresolved here

israelpost.co.il.note:
filed refusal-type on 30.9 (tick 31) and CORRECTED the same day (tick 33): the terms page answered 200 with a React shell whose only text is the title (research/rendered/terms-israel-post.txt:1; terms-israel-post.html has an empty
), carrying an invisible reCAPTCHA v3 score script (api.js?render=) and a Radware bot-manager sensor (perfdrive.com, stormcaster.js). No challenge page was served, so tick 31's 'a bot challenge' overstated it: scripts/capture-check.mjs classifies it js-shell. It fits neither of D2(iv)'s two kinds exactly (no 403 or challenge; no exhaustive search found nothing); whether a JS render of a terms page on a bot-managed host is allowed is FABLE_QUEUE row 21 (c). The line stays retired meanwhile: the terms are unread, and unread terms mean no fetch (ruling 30.9 16(d) D2(iv)). The registered-mail rate (documents ruling fold 11(c)) stays unread, so step 2's registered-mail notice stays recorded, not asked
